acd: 10 in humanoid form, 11 (natural armor) in bear and hybrid form
sp: ходьба 30 фт., notes 40 ft., climb 30 ft. in bear or hybrid form фт.
imm: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.d: The werebear can use its action to polymorph into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid or into a Large bear, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it. is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
The werebear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.d: In bear form, the werebear makes two claw attacks. In humanoid form, it makes two greataxe attacks. In hybrid form, it can attack like a bear or a humanoid.

Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with were bear lycanthropy.
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.

tips: Иммунитет к урону: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons — не тратьте на это ресурсы, ищите другой тип урона.
Слабый спасбросок: Ловкость / Интеллект (+0) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
Мультиатака — наносит несколько ударов за ход. Эффекты обездвиживания/оглушения особенно ценны против него.
